analysis.title: Accessing Anthropic Exposure via ETFs and Mutual Funds
key_insights: A small group of ETFs and mutual funds hold direct pre-IPO Anthropic exposure through late-stage funding rounds or secondary sales: ARKVX (4.5%), AGIX (3.5%), ATFV (1.2%), BAI (1.1%). Weights as of Nov 11, 2026 (ARKVX as of Oct 30).

On Nov 12, 2026, Roundhill launched MAGP, which gets synthetic Anthropic exposure through swaps referencing the BITA Anthropic Perpetual Futures Index. Anthropic was 6.7% of the portfolio at launch. Corgi's MN (7.3%) uses the same approach.

Tema Photonics & Optical ETF (LAZR) has the largest Anthropic weight excluding swap-based exposure, at about 12.7% of the portfolio, its largest holding. The exposure is held through an undisclosed SPV.

Direct holders are registered shareholders on Anthropic's cap table with the rights of their preferred series. SPV holders are not: the SPV is the shareholder of record, so the ETF has no voting, information or future-round rights.

Daily-creation ETFs such as AGIX, ATFV and BAI are limited by SEC Rule 22e-4, which caps illiquid holdings at 15% of net assets, so their Anthropic exposure ranged from 1.0% to 3.5%. Interval funds such as ARKVX can hold far more, with 70-80% of the portfolio in private companies.

Private-stake marks are infrequent and can diverge from value. ATFV bought Series G at about $259 per share on Mar 31, 2026. Alger marked it to about $589 by Jun 30 (+127% in one quarter) and to $674 per share as of Nov 11 (7,251 shares, $4,887,827 market value). Trades between revaluations may not reflect Anthropic's worth.

Perpetual futures on a private company have no independent spot reference price. The BITA index is built from thinly traded perpetual futures prices, so MAGP's Anthropic exposure reflects trader sentiment in a thin market.

At IPO, direct funds will mark at the daily exchange price, and any gap versus the last private mark hits the fund immediately. MAGP will swap into listed shares, and any gap between the perpetual futures price and the opening price becomes a gain or loss for the fund. LAZR must wait for the SPV manager to distribute or sell the shares, possibly after a lockup, and it is unclear whether the SPV shares carry a lockup.

Post-IPO index treatment differs. Nasdaq-100 trackers add Anthropic after 15 trading days. FTSE Russell trackers are eligible for fast-track entry after 5 trading days. The S&P 500 requires 12 months of trading and positive GAAP net income in the latest quarter and over the trailing four quarters. QQQ and IWB will therefore hold Anthropic much earlier than VOO.

crypto_views: Roundhill's MAGP (launched Nov 12, 2026) and Corgi's MN get Anthropic exposure through swaps on perpetual futures that trade on crypto exchanges. The BITA Anthropic Perpetual Futures Index takes the volume-weighted median price on each eligible platform and combines them into one weighted-average price.

Unlike Bitcoin perpetual futures, which reference an observable spot price, Anthropic perpetuals have no spot price. Each exchange must devise its own reference price, drawing on funding rounds or secondary trades.
risk_factors: Private-company valuation: funds mark Anthropic infrequently, so ETF prices between revaluations may not reflect its value.
The perpetual futures reference price is set by thinly traded markets with no independent observable value.
SPV structures disclose little. Tema has not disclosed LAZR's SPV, its manager, the source of the shares or the terms. Possible post-IPO lockup terms are unclear.
The gap between the last private mark or perpetual futures price and the IPO price will flow into fund NAV immediately after listing.

tension_points.bull_case: Direct holders such as ATFV and BAI are registered shareholders. Their marks have risen sharply (ATFV from $259 to $674 per share), and the IPO will replace the estimated mark with the daily exchange price.
tension_points.bear_case: Private marks are periodic and estimated, and perpetual futures prices reflect thin-market sentiment. Any gap to the IPO price will hit fund NAV immediately.
tension_points.what_invalidates: An IPO price or opening price well below the last private mark or perpetual futures level would produce an immediate loss in these funds.

theme_stances.key_argument: Funds reach Anthropic through direct equity, perpetual futures swaps or SPVs, and each route has different valuation, disclosure and rights trade-offs.
theme_stances.evidence: varied products allow investors to trade off different factors
